These compounds are likely modulators of the same biological process, possibly influencing the activity of Nuclear receptor coactivator 2. The scores from the two paths, though slightly different, both point to a consistent biological pathway, suggesting a plausible mechanism of action. The evidence is consistent but not entirely conclusive, as the exact role of the potassium-transporting ATPase subunit beta in the activation of Nuclear receptor coactivator 2 remains to be fully elucidated.
